problem_text:
An agricultural research team must deploy soil sensors across seven distinct experimental fields to monitor moisture levels.

The wireless transmission latencies between field stations, measured in milliseconds, are as follows:
* Station P to Q: 240.8 ms
* Station P to R: 174.9 ms
* Station P to S: 161.3 ms
* Station P to T: 141.4 ms
* Station P to U: 99.6 ms
* Station P to V: 185.6 ms
* Station Q to R: 67.5 ms
* Station Q to S: 142.0 ms
* Station Q to T: 104.6 ms
* Station Q to U: 159.3 ms
* Station Q to V: 69.3 ms
* Station R to S: 112.4 ms
* Station R to T: 51.2 ms
* Station R to U: 104.0 ms
* Station R to V: 49.5 ms
* Station S to T: 67.4 ms
* Station S to U: 63.6 ms
* Station S to V: 74.2 ms
* Station T to U: 55.1 ms
* Station T to V: 44.4 ms
* Station U to V: 94.1 ms

The objective is to determine the most efficient sequence for the data-collection drone to visit each field station precisely once, initiating and concluding its circuit at the same station, such that the total communication latency is minimized.
